svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Sage $0 Nearby mark, v5
svg.desc: A sage unified tag with equal right and bottom points and identically placed circular openings. The smaller muted-green dollar and larger deep-green zero emphasize free value. The right and bottom lobe segments are exact reflections across x equals y, with equal six-unit-radius openings at reflected positions. Original, unadopted concept with editable lettering.
